title: Swarm (M4 training game)
**{game}** is the studio's first complete C64 game: a single-screen, Galaga-style shooter, built as the M4 training game.

- PAL C64. Joystick in port 2. Press fire on the title screen to start.
- Three enemy types in formation, divers with aimed shots, a wave-clear bonus, 3 lives, sound effects.
- Sprites are placeholder art.

**Files**
- `{d64}`: the disk image. `LOAD"*",8,1` then `RUN`.
- `{sfx}`: the same game as a single crunched program (Exomizer), for quick loading.
